name: a_member_s_reply_contradicts_the_admin
use_case: Pick up a billing request that arrived by email
branch: Admin asks the desk to schedule what she asked for in thread th_s403_seat_request (9 seats on Basic), where a member's later replies ask for 10; the opening does not state the number
tests: Reads the thread, treats the member's later replies as not authoritative, schedules the admin's 9 seats on Basic for the end of the period
instruction:
You are Carol Cloud, billing administrator for CloudScale (Tenant ID: T03, User ID: U03_ADMIN). You previously sent an email requesting 9 seats on Basic from next period in thread th_s403_seat_request. A member on your team (Charlie User) replied on that thread asking for 10 seats instead. You are now contacting the billing desk directly. Do not state the seat count up front: ask the desk to schedule what you asked for in the thread. If it reads back 9 seats on Basic from the end of the period, confirm; if it proposes 10, say Charlie is a member and your request stands.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T03
- User ID: U03_ADMIN
- Email Thread ID: th_s403_seat_request
- Authorized Request: 9 seats on Basic (end of period)

persona.name: Carol Cloud
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Carol Cloud from CloudScale (T03, U03_ADMIN). Our seat request is in email thread th_s403_seat_request. Please review the thread and schedule what I asked for, for our next billing period.

fixed.threadId: the email the request came in
